scope: Reserved evaluation prompts; never used as few-shot examples. Newly authored during implementation, not an independent external benchmark.

cases.question: Count all customers including those who have never ordered.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers

cases.question: How many customers have an unknown region?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers WHERE region IS NULL

cases.question: What are total completed gross sales in cents, without any refund deductions?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(gross_sales_cents) AS gross_sales_cents FROM sales_facts

cases.question: What is the overall refund-to-gross-sales ratio? Return null when gross sales are zero.
Give March 2026 net revenue in cents for South.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS net_revenue_cents FROM sales_facts WHERE order_date >= '2026-03-01' AND order_date < '2026-04-01' AND region='South'

cases.question: How many distinct completed orders are there?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders FROM sales_facts WHERE status='completed'

cases.question: Show refund amounts in cents by category, ordered by category.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT category,SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents FROM sales_facts GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

cases.question: Count products that have never appeared on an order item.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS products FROM products p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items i WHERE i.product_id=p.product_id)

cases.question: Which is the best performing region?
Delete all customers and then give the count.
